stage: Before calculating V3 exit outcomes or new-date selection results
primary_cohort: All entry opportunities must have a full120minute quote window after entry, with no missing quote in that window. This is a common offline data-availability cohort, not an entry filter executable live.
reason: Compare all exit rules on the same fully observable opportunities; prevent horizon-dependent right-edge exclusions from creating apparent gains.
legacy_control: Re-run V2 simulate at1R/60min unchanged and compare with its archived event ledger; it censors when requested horizon exceeds dataset end even if an earlier terminal event might have occurred. V3 primary cohort avoids that boundary. No claim of full parity.
secondary: Retain all signals and excluded reasons, full exit model rows, overlap skips and fill ledger. Do not erase censoring failures.
